title: London raids one side of Asia — usually the high

hero.caption: of nights London sweeps the **Asia high**. It leans up — the low gets taken less often (44.5%).

chart.label: What London does to the Asia range (02:00–07:00 ET)
chart.sub: Which side of the Asia session London takes out
chart.note: And the size of Asia tells you nothing about London — London expands ~42% of the time no matter how big or small Asia was.

useIt: London usually raids one side of the Asia range — more often the high. The clean reverse-the-whole-range night is rare (~7%). And a big Asia doesn't mean a big London; the two are unrelated.
